name: Federation agent
source: An agent from the Galactic Federation, who contacts Samus about the distress signal on Planet XR-699. [spoiler]He works on a plan for the Federation to humiliate Samus after her act of insubordination when she chose to destroy the X parasites in Metroid Fusion.[spoiler]
